name: Ro-BassFishing [MASSIVEE UPDATE]
desc:
🎣 Ro-BassFishing: cast, watch the strike, land the big one!

Fish a full-size recreation of Lake Seminole on the Georgia–Florida line, from the Sneads Park boat ramp to the cypress-lined creeks and bluffs.

CODES: KENTUCKYDAN, 5MVISITS

🐟 HOW IT PLAYS
- Aim your cast, then follow your lure underwater
- Watch bass chase it down and strike right in front of you
- Set the hook and fight them in, harder for the big ones
- Twitch, reel and switch between worm, crankbait, spinnerbait and topwater frog

💰 PROGRESS
- Grab a free starter rod at Earl's Seminole Bait & Tackle
- Sell your catch and buy better rods, reels and lures
- Your cash, gear and fish are saved

🚤 ON THE WATER
- Drive the Langer X500 bass boat: trim, jack plate and real engine sounds
- Fish with friends and watch each other's catches
- Day and night cycle on a living lake

Plays on PC, mobile and controller.
